Overview

Gjakova is a city in Gjakova with a population of 40,000. A city in western Kosovo known for its historic bazaar (Çarshia e Madhe), the Hadum Mosque, and its traditional craftsmanship and music scene. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
